site.lema: Free-licensed retro, educational and Bible games. Free to play, no sign-up.
secao.retro.desc: New games made for classic consoles, published under a free license or with the author's permission.
secao.educativos.desc: Math, geography and language skills in quick arcade-style games.
secao.biblicos.desc: Bible stories and characters in quizzes and games for the whole family.
catalogo.vazio: The first games are being selected. Come back soon!
jogo.player.embreve: The emulator arrives in the next phase of the site.
sobre.p1: Play in your browser, for free, with no account. Your progress is saved on your own device.
sobre.p2: We only publish games under a free license or with the author's written permission. Commercial games from companies such as Nintendo or SNK are not part of the catalog.
sobre.p3: The educational and Bible games are made by our team. Quoted Bible text comes from public-domain translations.
sobre.p4: The site is supported by Google ads, placed outside the game area.
sobre.remocao: Are you the author of a game listed here and want it taken down? Open a request in the site's repository and it will be removed within 48 hours.
creditos.intro: Each game belongs to its author and is published here under the license shown. Thanks to everyone who released their games.
